summary: Rift-Heart is the dimensional core of Discord, where chaotic energy condenses into temporal fractures, Void breaches, and Discordian maelstroms. It is the most dangerous region of Discord-Core.
history: Formed when the First Fracture collapsed inward, creating a dimensional singularity.
Temporal instability spread outward, causing time loops and event echoes.
Void breaches opened, linking Discord to the cosmic emptiness beyond reality.
Riftseekers attempted containment but failed to stabilize the core.
The Heart of the Rift became the nexus of Discordian corruption.
